description: Routes du Maroc is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, credited on the ArcGIS item to Geomatic, the Esri distributor for Morocco and Mauritania. Le Royaume du Maroc a accordé une grande importance aux infrastructures routières, vu leurs impacts sur le développement économique, social et touristique du pays. Elles participent également à l’aménagement équilibré du territoire et permettent de soutenir les investissements et le désenclavement des populations rurales. Coverage: Morocco. The portal feed leaves its publisher field as an unfilled template; the ArcGIS item (owner Geomatic_content) names Geomatic as the credit line. Its tags are Routes, Maroc, Morocco, Réseau routier. The portal shows 2018-05-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom rights statement written on the portal listing (long text, see the linked page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
